items.text: The process that loads this table is not included in the available files. All 2.58 million rows were written by the same system, identified only by the label 'SUNOCO via EME'

The CARD_TYPE field is empty on every one of the 2.58 million rows, even though the field exists both in this table's schema and in the related extract file's own columns. A later file export supplies the pre-staging loader's own column layout, which marks this field MISSING=ON, but 18 of the file's other 23 columns carry the same flag: a blanket tolerance on this error-capture descriptor, not a signal specific to CARD_TYPE. It does not explain why CARD_TYPE is the one blank on every single row

A related file was found that extracts data from a similar source, a Sunoco location report, into a plain export file rather than into this table. Its columns closely match this table's own columns, which suggests the same underlying source likely feeds this table, but that is not confirmed

'EME', the name identifying the system that writes to this table, is not explained anywhere in the available records. The same name identifies the writer of the Club Card dimension table as well, and is confirmed live and current on both tables

A pre-staging loader, inferred to be named df_build_pstg_sunoco_fuel_prtnr_prgm_f by stripping the _DBMSERR suffix from its own FILENAME= field, is now confirmed to have existed: its DBMS-error master file, listing this table's exact column layout, survives in a later file export. The loader's own .fex script, and therefore its transformation logic and any schedule, is still not among the files we have
No invalid record keys, no placeholder club card values, and no duplicate business keys were found across any of the 2.58 million rows

items.text: It has not been confirmed which system actually loads new data into this table. A related source, a Sunoco location report, was found, but it has not been proven to be the real feed
items.note: This table is live and growing daily, so confirming its true source matters for planning the migration

items.text: It is unclear what system or platform 'EME' refers to. The same name identifies the writer of both this table and the Club Card dimension table, and is confirmed live and current on both
items.note: Understanding it would clarify how much of the loyalty and rewards data relies on the same system, and whether other tables use it without yet being recognized

items.text: Whether CARD_TYPE is ever populated by the upstream Sunoco/EME feed in practice is unconfirmed. Its loader's error-capture layout tolerates a blank value on this field, but so do 18 other columns in the same descriptor (19 of 24 total), so this does not explain why CARD_TYPE alone is blank on every one of 2.58 million rows
items.note: It has been empty across the table's entire history; this is still a real gap, not one the newer file evidence resolves

blocks.text: A few things below are still not fully confirmed. We are sharing this table's analysis now rather than holding it back, because the rest of it is solid and these gaps are clearly called out here, not hidden.
